problem_text: Centrifugal Pump P-302 six-monthly planned maintenance. Bearing inspection, mechanical seal check and coupling alignment verification.
action_text: Inspect bearing condition and clearances. Replenish grease per lubrication schedule Mobil SHC 220. Check coupling alignment. Verify seal flush flow rate. Update maintenance record.

problem_text: Reactor R-201 jacket leak confirmed. Pressure decay test failed on zone 224 at 3.1 bar.
action_text: Identify leak location on jacket weld seam using nitrogen pressure test. Weld repair by certified welder. Post weld heat treat if required. Retest at 1.5x design pressure.

problem_text: Ultrafiltration Unit UF-02 quarterly membrane integrity test and chemical clean.
action_text: Perform air pressure decay integrity test on all modules. Record results. Chemical clean with citric acid and sodium hypochlorite per SOP. Re-test flux after cleaning.

problem_text: Gas Scrubber GS-01 high H2S outlet alarm 124 ppm. Scrubbing efficiency loss. Chemical depletion.
action_text: Increase caustic dosing rate. Check pH of scrubbing liquor. Top up caustic tank. Inspect spray nozzles for wear and blockage. Replace nozzles if worn. Verify outlet H2S after adjustment.

problem_text: Compressor K-01 high vibration trip. NDE bearing vibration 253.0 mm/s peak.
action_text: Replace NDE bearing. Check shaft alignment. Inspect labyrinth seals. Rebalance rotor if indicated. Run up on no-load and verify vibration levels.

problem_text: Centrifugal Pump P-202 cavvitating intermittently. Suction pressure 260.10 bar below minimum NPSH required.
action_text: Check suction strainer differential pressure. Clean strainer basket. Verify suction vessel level. Adjust operating point to restore positive NPSH.

problem_text: Dryer DRY-101 six-monthly steam trap inspection and condenser cleaning.
action_text: Test all steam traps for correct operation. Replace failed traps. Clean condenser coils. Check vacuum pump condition. Verify all instruments are calibrated.

problem_text: Centrifugal Pump P-101 bearing temperature high alarm drive end. Temperature 114 degC above baseline.
action_text: Remove bearing housing end cover. Measure bearing clearance. Replace worn bearing. Re-grease per lubrication schedule. Monitor temperature for 2 hours post start.

problem_text: Evaporator EV-01 annual evaporator cleaning and tube inspection.
action_text: Drain and clean heating tubes with EDTA solution. Inspect tube bundle using eddy current testing. Replace any thinned tubes. Pressure test. Update inspection records.

problem_text: Hydraulic Press HP-01 hydraulic oil leak from cylinder rod seal. Estimated 134.3 L/h.
action_text: Depressurise hydraulic circuit fully. Replace cylinder rod seal and wiper ring. Inspect rod surface for scoring. Hone rod if minor scoring. Refill oil to correct level. Leak test at operating pressure.

problem_text: Motor M-04 six-monthly insulation resistance test and bearing grease replenishment.
action_text: IR test all three phases and record. Grease drive end and non-drive end bearings per lubrication schedule. Check terminal connections for heat damage. Document results.

problem_text: Cooling Tower CT-01 high conductivity alarm 220 uS/cm. Blowdown valve failed closed.
action_text: Manually open blowdown valve to flush system. Inspect valve actuator and replace if faulty. Verify automatic blowdown control loop functioning. Check water treatment dosing.

problem_text: Distillation Column DC-01 reboiler steam control valve CV failure. Valve stuck at 56% open.
action_text: Isolatе cοntrol vаlve. Remove aсtuator and рositioner. Disassemble valve body. Inspеct seаt аnd plug for erοsion. Reрlacе trim if worn. Cаlibrate pοsitioner аnd stroke test.

problem_text: Storage Tank TK-01 annual calibration of all level and temperature instruments.
action_text: Calibrate all level transmitters against certified reference. Check temperature sensor accuracy. Verify high level alarm setpoints. Update calibration records.

problem_text: Distillation Column DC-01 annual reboiler and condenser inspection.
action_text: Open reboiler bundle. Eddy current tube inspection. Replace damaged tubes. Clean condenser tubes. Pressure test both vessels. Update inspection records.

problem_text: Compressor K-03 annual overhaul per OEM schedule. Valve inspection, oil change and performance test.
action_text: Disassemble suction and discharge valve assemblies. Replace valve plates and springs. Change lube oil and filters. Check coupling and alignment. Performance test.

problem_text: Belt Conveyor CV-201 annual gearbox oil change and drive inspection.
action_text: Drain gearbox. Replace oil with approved grade. Inspect coupling and guard condition. Check brake adjustment. Verify all safety switches and interlocks operational.

problem_text: Storage Tank TK-03 level transmitter LT failure. Reading stuck at 86% suspect impulse line blockage.
action_text: Isolate and remove level transmitter. Blow down impulse lines. Clean displacer float. Bench calibrate. Reinstall and verify reading against dip measurement.

problem_text: Separator SEP-01 liquid dump valve failing to open. Liquid accumulation in vessel.
action_text: Isolate dump valve. Remove actuator. Inspect valve body for erosion and debris. Replace seat and trim. Actuator service. Stroke test under pressure. Verify automatic control.

problem_text: Evaporator EV-02 product carryover into condenser. Entrainment separator fouled.
action_text: Remove and clean entrainment separator mesh pads. Inspect for damage. Replace if mesh is blocked or torn. Verify separator performance post cleaning.

problem_text: Centrifugal Pump P-401 motor current increasing trend. Current draw 12.4 A versus baseline 147.5 A. Possible internal wear.
action_text: Inspect impeller and wear rings for erosion. Measure internal clearances. Replace worn components. Re-test performance at duty conditions.

problem_text: Motor M-04 annual motor inspection including terminal box and cooling fan check.
action_text: Inspect terminal box for moisture ingress and loose connections. Clean cooling fins and fan guard. Check mounting bolts. Verify earthing continuity. Test run and measure current balance.

problem_text: Centrifugal Pump P-102 high vibration alarm on drive end bearing. Amplitude 141.1 mm/s RMS exceeding trip setpoint.
action_text: Isolate pump, drain casing, disassemble bearing housing. Replace drive end bearing NU2316. Realign coupling to within 0.05mm TIR. Functional test at duty point.

problem_text: Dosing Pump DOS-03 annual calibration and flow verification.
action_text: Calibrate dosing pump using certified flow measurement method. Verify actual versus setpoint flow across operating range. Adjust if outside tolerance. Document calibration results.

problem_text: Heat Exchanger HX-03 differential pressure high alarm. Tube side pressure drop 212.00 bar versus clean baseline 100.30 bar.
action_text: Isolate and drain tube side. Hydroblast tube bundle to remove fouling deposit. Inspect tube wall thickness using eddy current testing. Reassemble and pressure test.

problem_text: Storage Tank TK-05 API 653 internla inspection. Floor, shell and roof condition assessment.
action_text: Drain and gas free tank. Internal inspection per API 653. Measure floor plate thickness using UT. Inspect shell for corrosion. Check annular plates. Write inspection report.

problem_text: Gas Scrubber GS-01 high differential pressure alarm 91 mbar. Packing section flooding suspected.
action_text: Reduce gas flow rate to resolve flooding. Inspect liquid distribution nozzles for blockage. Clean packing. Verify liquid-to-gas ratio within design envelope. Investigate cause of flooding.

problem_text: Belt Conveyor CV-101 blocked chute. Material buildup causing belt overload trip.
action_text: Clear chute blockage. Inspect chute liner wear. Replace worn liner plates. Investigate root cause of blockage. Adjust belt speed or chute geometry if required.

problem_text: Fluid Catalytic Cracker FCC-02 standpipe pluggage event. Catalyst circulation lost.
action_text: Implement catalyst aeration procedure to restore standpipe flow. Inspect aeration taps for blockage. Clear any aeration line pluggage. Monitor catalyst density profile after recovery.

problem_text: Fluid Catalytic Cracker FCC-02 planned turnaround. Regenerator and reactor internal inspection.
action_text: Full turnaround inspection of regenerator cyclones, reactor riser and stripper internals. Replace worn refractory. Inspect all slide valves. Replace catalyst addition and withdrawal systems.

problem_text: Centrifuge CF-02 basket screen failure. Product fines in filtrate above specification.
action_text: Remove basket. Replace damaged screen panel. Inspect basket welds. Reassemble and perform integrity test with water. Verify filtrate quality before restarting production.

problem_text: Centrifugal Pump P-202 mechanical seal failure. Product leakage observed at gland area estimated 296.1 L/h.
action_text: Replace complete mechanical seal cartridge. Flush seal chamber, pressure test at 11.3 bar. Return to service and monitor seal flush flow.

problem_text: Gas Scrubber GS-101 six-monthly sump inspection and recirculation pump service.
action_text: Drain and inspect sump for sediment and corrosion. Clean sump. Service recirculation pump. Replace mechanical seal. Clean recirculation strainer. Refill and verify liquid distribution.

problem_text: Compressor K-201 lube oil analysis shows elevated iron particles 122 ppm. Bearing wear suspected.
action_text: Inspect bearings and journal surfaces. Replace worn bearings. Flush and refill lube oil system. Repeat oil analysis after 200 hours runtime.

problem_text: Motor M-03 six-monthly insulation resistance test and bearing grease replenishment.
action_text: IR test all three phases and record. Grease drive end and non-drive end bearings per lubrication schedule. Check terminal connections for heat damage. Document results.

problem_text: Evaporator EV-101 six-monthly vacuum pump service and oil change.
action_text: Drain vacuum pump oil. Inspect pump internals for wear. Replace shaft seal. Refill with correct oil grade. Run up and verify vacuum level achieved.

problem_text: Screw Conveyor SC-02 end bearing failure. Screw shaft vibration detected.
action_text: Remove end bearing housing. Replace worn bearing. Inspect shaft journal for scoring. Check shaft alignment. Grease bearing per lubrication schedule. Trial run before loading.

problem_text: Dosing Pump DOS-03 six-monthly diaphragm replacement and valve inspection.
action_text: Replace dosing diaphragm as preventive measure. Inspect suction and discharge valves. Replace worn valve components. Flush dosing head. Calibrate stroke and verify flow rate.

problem_text: Filter F-01 quarterly filter housing inspection and O-ring check.
action_text: Inspect O-ring condition and housing sealing surfaces. Replace O-ring as precautionary measure. Pressure test housing. Verify differential pressure indication.

problem_text: Centrifugal Pump P-501 six-monthly planned maintenance. Bearing inspection, mechanical seal check and coupling alignment verification.
action_text: Inspect bearing condition and clearances. Replenish grease per lubrication schedule Total Carter EP 220. Check coupling alignment. Verify seal flush flow rate. Update maintenance record.

problem_text: Sepаratοr SEP-02 interface lеvеl control erratiс. LT-209 suspected fouling on displaсer.
action_text: Remove level transmitter. Clean displacer float. Calibrate instrument using water column. Replace isolation valves on bridle if passing. Reinstall and verify control response.

problem_text: Centrifugal Pump P-301 vibration trending upward over 30 days. Broadband velocity 18.4 mm/s. Bearing defect frequency identified in spectrum.
action_text: Vibration analysis confirms bearing fault. Replace drive end bearing proactively. Re-baseline vibration signature after repair.

problem_text: Storage Tank TK-102 API 653 internal inspection. Floor, shell and roof condition assessment.
action_text: Drain and gas free tank. Internal inspection per API 653. Measure floor plate thickness using UT. Inspect shell for corrosion. Check annular plates. Write inspection report.

problem_text: Centrifugal Pump P-601 quarterly lubrication service. Bearing grease replenishment and vibration baseline measurement.
action_text: Grease drive end and non-drive end bearings. Measure and record vibration signature. Check motor current at duty point. Inspect coupling spider for wear.

problem_text: Motor M-08 VFD overcurrent fault. Drive tripped on F0002 at 296.4 A.
action_text: Check VFD parameters and fault log. Inspect motor terminal connections. Megger test windings. Check encoder feedback signal. Clear fault and trial run under reduced load.

problem_text: Boiler BLR-101 feedwater pump failure. Loss of boiler feed. Emergency shutdown initiated.
action_text: Start standby feedwater pump. Investigate duty pump failure. Replace mechanical seal and bearings on duty pump. Test duty pump before returning to service.

problem_text: Distillation Column DC-01 reboiler steam control valve CV failure. Valve stuck at 56% open.
action_text: Isolate control valve. Remove actuator and positioner. Disassemble valve body. Inspect seat and plug for erosion. Replace trim if worn. Calibrate positioner and stroke test.

problem_text: Fluid Catalytic Cracker FCC-02 planned turnaround. Regenerator and reactor internal inspection.
action_text: Full turnaround inspection of regenerator cyclones, reactor riser and stripper internals. Replace worn refractory. Inspect all slide valves. Replace catalyst addition and withdrawal systems.

problem_text: HVAC Unit HV-01 HEPA filter differential pressure high-high alarm. DP 291 Pa. Cleanroom qualification at risk.
action_text: Isolate HVAC unit. Replace HEPA filter cassette. Seal integrity test with particle counter. Verify room pressure recovery. Document in GxP qualification record.

problem_text: Centrifugal Pump P-101 vibration trending upward over 30 days. Broadband velocity 265.4 mm/s. Bearing defect frequency identified in spectrum.
action_text: Vibration analysis confirms bearing fault. Replace drive end bearing proactively. Re-baseline vibration signature after repair.

problem_text: Storage Tank TK-04 roof drain blockage causing water ingress to product.
action_text: Clear roof drain blockage. Inspect drain seal condition. Replace corroded drain fitting. Verify drain flow rate post repair.

problem_text: Storage Tank TK-101 outlet valve passing. Confirmed by downstream flow with valve closed.
action_text: Isolate valve. Disassemble. Inspect seat and ball/gate for erosion. Lap seat if minor damage. Replace valve internals if worn beyond tolerance.

problem_text: Centrifuge CF-01 annual full overhaul including spindle bearing replacement.
action_text: Full disassembly. Replace spindle bearings. Inspect basket for fatigue cracks. Replace all seals. Reassemble, balance basket, and perform no-load and loaded test run.

problem_text: Compressor K-201 low lube oil pressure alarm. Oil pressure 201.70 bar below minimum. Unit tripped.
action_text: Drain and inspect lube oil system. Replace oil filter cartridges. Check oil pump relief valve. Refill with approved oil grade. Run up and verify pressure.

problem_text: Centrifugal Pump P-202 quarterly lubrication service. Bearing grease replenishment and vibration baseline measurement.
action_text: Grease drive end and non-drive end bearings. Measure and record vibration signature. Check motor current at duty point. Inspect coupling spider for wear.

problem_text: Centrifugal Pump P-501 motor current increasing trend. Current draw 131.2 A versus baseline 1.8 A. Possible internal wear.
action_text: Inspect impeller and wear rings for erosion. Measure internal clearances. Replace worn components. Re-test performance at duty conditions.

problem_text: Heat Exchanger HX-03 annual inspection. Tube bundle inspection, gasket replacement and pressure test.
action_text: Drain and open channel head. Inspect tube sheet and tubes using boroscope. Replace gaskets on both heads. Hydraulic pressure test. Reinstate and commission.

problem_text: Dryer DRY-101 six-monthly steam trap inspection and condenser cleaning.
action_text: Test all steam traps for correct operation. Replace failed traps. Clean condenser coils. Check vacuum pump condition. Verify all instruments are calibrated.

problem_text: Filter F-201 differential pressure high-high alarm. DP 265.20 bar. Cartridges blocked. Production stopped.
action_text: Isolate filter. Drain housing. Remove and replace all 1 filter cartridges with grade 0.2 micron. Inspect housing for damage. Reassemble and pressure test.

problem_text: Heat Exchanger HX-04 six-monthly fouling inspection based on duty criticality.
action_text: Measure differential pressure and calculate fouling factor. If above threshold clean tube bundle. Inspect sacrificial anodes. Document condition in RBI record.

problem_text: Centrifugаl Pump P-103 meсhanicаl seаl failure. Produсt leakage observеd аt gland areа estimаted 276.2 L/h.
action_text: Replace complete mechanical seal cartridge. Flush seal chamber, pressure test at 3.7 bar. Return to service and monitor seal flush flow.

problem_text: heat exchanger hx-01 differential pressure high alarm. tube side pressure drop 68.50 bar versus clean baseline 157.70 bar.
action_text: Isolate and drain tube side. Hydroblast tube bundle to remove fouling deposit. Inspect tube wall thickness using eddy current testing. Reassemble and pressure test.
Inspect gas turbine internals via borescope. Identify blade damage or fouling. Compressor wash offline. If blade damage confirmed plan major inspection. Replace DE bearing if worn.

problem_text: storage tank tk-04 api 653 internal inspection. floor, shell and roof condition assessment.
action_text: Drain and gas free tank. Internal inspection per API 653. Measure floor plate thickness using UT. Inspect shell for corrosion. Check annular plates. Write inspection report.

problem_text: hEAT eXCHANGER hx-101 OUTLET TEMPERATURE LOW. hEAT TRANSFER COEFFICIENT 29 w/M2k BELOW DESIGN 20 w/M2k.
action_text: Chemical clean tube side with sodium hydroxide 5% solution for 4 hours. Flush with demineralised water. Re-baseline heat transfer performance.

problem_text: centrifuge cf-02 basket screen failure. product fines in filtrate above specification.
action_text: Remove basket. Replace damaged screen panel. Inspect basket welds. Reassemble and perform integrity test with water. Verify filtrate quality before restarting production.
Isolate conveyor. Remove drive pulley lagging. Clean pulley surface. Apply new ceramic lagging using approved adhesive. Cure before return to service. Verify belt tension.

Inspect screw flight wear profile. Measure flight thickness at wear points. Replace screw section if below minimum thickness. Lubricate all bearings. Check seals at inlet and outlet.

problem_text: Screw Conveyor Sc-02 Blocked. Motor Overload Trip. Material Compaction In Trough.
action_text: Isolate and lockout. Access clean out ports to clear material compaction. Check for foreign material in product. Inspect screw for damage. Verify material properties within design spec.
Implement catalyst aeration procedure to restore standpipe flow. Inspect aeration taps for blockage. Clear any aeration line pluggage. Monitor catalyst density profile after recovery.

problem_text: Agitator A-G101 gearbox oil temperature high. Temperature 185 degC above alarm setpoint.
action_text: Drain gearbox. Inspect internal gears and bearings for damage. Replace oil. Clean oil cooler if fitted. If bearing damaged replace and refill. Run up and monitor temperature.

problem_text: hEAT eXCHANGER hx-01 DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE HIGH ALARM. tUBE SIDE PRESSURE DROP 68.50 BAR VERSUS CLEAN BASELINE 157.70 BAR.
action_text: Isolate and drain tube side. Hydroblast tube bundle to remove fouling deposit. Inspect tube wall thickness using eddy current testing. Reassemble and pressure test.

problem_text: filter f-01 quarterly filter housing inspection and o-ring check.
action_text: Inspect O-ring condition and housing sealing surfaces. Replace O-ring as precautionary measure. Pressure test housing. Verify differential pressure indication.
Adjust tail pulley tracking screws to correct belt alignment. Inspect all return rollers for seized bearings causing mistrack. Replace seized rollers. Monitor belt tracking for 2 hours.

action_text: Chеmical clean tubе sidе with sodium hydroxide 5% solution for 4 hours. Flush with demineralised water. Re-basеline heat transfer рerformancе.

problem_text: belt conveyor cv-03 blocked chute. material buildup causing belt overload trip.
action_text: Clear chute blockage. Inspect chute liner wear. Replace worn liner plates. Investigate root cause of blockage. Adjust belt speed or chute geometry if required.
Walk full conveyor length. Inspect belt condition and splices. Replace damaged or seized idler rollers. Check belt tension. Lubricate all grease points. Test emergency pull cord.

problem_text: centrifugal pump p-101 six-monthly planned maintenance. bearing inspection, mechanical seal check and coupling alignment verification.
action_text: Inspect bearing condition and clearances. Replenish grease per lubrication schedule Castrol Tribol 800. Check coupling alignment. Verify seal flush flow rate. Update maintenance record.
